name: Narberth Foodbank
short_description: Nearest foodbank at Narberth. Part of The Trussell Trust network. Open Tue 12-2pm for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Pembrokeshire County Council Allotments
short_description: Pembrokeshire Council allotment sites in Clynderwen area
description: Small plots available in the Clynderwen/Begelly area. From £18/year. Contact council for current availability and waiting lists.

name: Clynderwen Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Clynderwen Memorial Hall
description: Volunteer-run garden maintaining raised beds behind the memorial hall. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open Sundays 10am-2pm.
